tei:div.tei:p: "$ (499)༄༅// grub chen o rgyan pa'i gdams ngag rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung

bzhugs so// (500)༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ grub chen o rgyan pa ratna shrī nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du phebs pa'i tshe sprul zhing dhū ma sthā la'i gnas ka so ka'i grong khyer gyi dbus su rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mngon sum du rjes su bzung zhing dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i nges gsang mthar thug pa rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub 'di nyid gnang bas phyi nang gi chos thams cad mngon du gyur te dngos grub mchog brnyes pa yin la/ grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhir bzhugs pa'i jo ki ma chen mo bzhi mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i ngo bor snang bas kyang thabs lam gyi gdams pa zab mo gnang ba yin no// de la rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung 'di la/ ༈ thog mar lus rtsa dag par byed pa sku rdo rje sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyi yan lag bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor la/ so sor sdud pa skyil krung gsum gyis steng 'og bar gyi rlung bcing ba la/ steng gi skyil krung*/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rtsa yi bcud// nam mkha'i mthongs su gza' rnams brtan par bcings// 'og gi skyil krung*/ rgya mtsho'i gting du rtsa gsum yan lag bsam/ zhar byung bar gyi skyil krung dang*/ de ltar bcings pa'i dgos pa gsungs pas/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung gi tshogs// ster 'og rtsa yis bcings (501)pas zin par 'gyur// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bdag nyid can// 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nang du 'gag par byed/ ༈ de'i rtags dang bsam gtan gyi yan lag 'char tshul gsungs pa/ bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin las su rung*// 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nang du zin pa yis// rtags dang yon tan rnams ni rim gyis 'char/ ༈ gnyis pa ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung rdo rje nye bsnyen srog 'dzin gyi yan lag la/ 'og thur sel gyi rlung gis 'byung ba rim brtsegs bsgom par gsungs pa/

nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa rnams kyi// thur du bsdams pas dkyil 'khor gsal bar blta// steng srog rtsol gyi rlung gi sa bon gyi yig 'bru bskyed par gsungs pas/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bdag nyid kyi// yig 'bru'i rgyu ba ā li kā li'i rlung*// yi ge gsum gyi steng du bsdams pa las// srog thur gang zin kyang lam du 'gro ba/ steng 'gags pa las 'og tu zin 'gyur te// thur du zin pas steng yang de bzhin no// de dag brtan pa dang*/ bar rlung la brten nas phyag mtshan bskyed pa/ rdo rje ral gri rin chen padma dang*// 'khor lo rnams ni rim bzhin gsal (502)bar byed// bum can gyi sbyor ba gsungs pa/ steng 'og bar du bsdams pas thob bar 'gyur/ ༈ kha sbyor la brten lha sku gsal gdab pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor gsungs pa/ snod bcud tha mal 'dzin pa rab spangs te// gang na yig 'bru phyag mtshan gsal ba las// rigs las skyes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku// gdan dang long bu ske rags tshangs skud dang*// phyag mtshan zhal dang spyan dang skra mtshams dang*// rgyan dang cha lugs ma lus rab rdzogs pa// gtsug tor bar du rim pa bzhin du blta// gtsug tor nas bzung gdan la'ang de bzhin no// srog rtsol gyi yan lag rdo rje'i bzlas par 'gyur ba/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rtsa ba'i rlung rnams kyang*// de dus sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas par 'gyur// zhar la phrin las 'grub ba'i rnal 'byor gsungs pa/ rang rang rigs kyis 'byung ba'i kha dog bzhis// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod rim pa bzhin/ ༈ / yid thig le dag par byed pa thugs rdo rje'i phyed snga ma sgrub pa rjes dran gyi yan lag gsungs pa/ 'byung ba'i rlung rnams rang rang 'dzin stangs kyis// bskyod par gyur tshe rlung gis me spar nas// dwangs ma bzhu bas mi zad nyon mongs 'bar/ ro drug zos shing 'thung bas lus zung bdun du 'gyur tshul gsungs pa/

rtsigs ma bad kan chu ser khrag dang ni// sha dang rgyus pa rus pa'i bcud rnams las// rang rang gnas su nad dang lus zungs bskyed// lus kyi dwangs ma phyi rol du 'phos pa'i skyon gsungs pa/ lus zungs zla ba'i cha yis 'pho ba las// yan lag bcu gnyis srid pa'i lugs bzhin 'khor// lus zungs kyi dwangs ma 'phel ba'i dgos pa gsungs pa/ sgra gcan gyis ni rab tu zos pa las// me phung rab tu 'bar bas sreg par byed// rtsigs ma phyung ba dang dwangs ma rgyas pa'i thabs gsungs pa/ rtsigs ma thur du song bas nad med cing*// dwangs ma lus la rgyas pas bde (503)dang stobs/ ༈ thugs rdo rje'i phyed phyi ma sgrub pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag gsungs pa/ rigs drug sa bon bsregs par gyur pa las// 'dzag pa'i bde ba rim gyis skye ba'i phyir// steng 'og bar gsum rab tu bsdam par bya// ting nge 'dzin gyi las gsungs pa/ rlung gis me sbar sa sreg chu bzhu ste// nam mkha' stong pa'i don la 'jug par 'gyur// des ma grub na sbogs pa'i cho ga nā da goms pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ rdo rje bslang zhing gsor ba'i bde ba yis// thog ma bar dang mtha' yi bde ba 'char// dgug gzhug bcing zhing ro mnyam brtan par bya// rim pa des ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ sgrub pa chen po'i rten gyi mtshan nyid/ thabs kyi me gsum rab tu 'bar ba dang*// shes rab la yang me gsum de bzhin te// shes rab thabs kyi rigs dang rigs can gyi 'brel ba gsungs pa/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams te// nam mkha' las skyes de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum// thabs dang rgyal ba rnams kyis rab phye ba// rang rang rigs dang lus dang bsam pa la// rigs gzhan rnams dang 'dres pa gang la yang*// de dang de yi yab yum rigs kyis 'grub// yang na thabs kyang zla ba nyi ma'i rigs// shes rab kyang ni nyi ma zla ba'o// khams dwangs ma dag sgra gcan gyis za ba'i tshul gsungs pa/

'khor lo drug dang nor bu'i rtse mo la// zla ba'i cha rnams kyis ni 'pho ba dag /sgra gcan gyis ni rab tu zos pa las// de yi rjes su nyi ma'i cha rnams dang*// rim pa bzhin du de ni za bar 'gyur// zhar la khams lhag ma gzhan za bar gsungs pa/ nyi zla zos pa'i rjes la dri chen dang*// dri chu sha chen dbus kyi bcud kyang za// rtsigs ma bad kan dbus kyi khrag zos nas// sha dang rus pa rtsa rnams ma lus za// 'di yan gyis rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dngos gzhi bstan zin pa yin la/ de'ang dkyus kyi sa (504) bcad ni bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhir dbye ba'i dbang du byas te mchan rnying par ji ltar snang ba bzhin bris pa ste/ gzhan du sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor lus gnad kyi byed pa bcings pa sor sdud dag /de'i 'bras bu bsam gtan/ gsung rdo rje sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor steng 'og gi rlung lam du byed pa srog rtsol dang*/ kha sbyor la brten nas lha sku gsal gdab pa 'dzin pa/ thugs rdo rje sgrub pa chen po'i rnal 'byor gtum mo'i mes bde ba bsgrub pa rjes dran dang*/ 'dzag med du 'ching ba ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/ ting 'dzin gyi yan lag mthar thug gi 'bras bur rnam par bzhag pa'i dbang du byas na/ gtum mo dang*/ thig le'i rnal 'byor thams cad rjes dran du 'dug go /de ltar bsnyen sgrub gsum du rnam par bzhag pas mtshon dbye bsdu ci rigs pa dang*/ so so'i sa mtshams la'ang ngos bzung 'dra min 'ga' zhig 'byung na'ang don du 'gal ba med par shes par bya'o// de lta bu'i lam nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bogs 'don dang*/ gegs sel/ las des grub pa'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu rnams rim bzhin du ston par bzhed nas/ thog mar/ ༈ bogs dbyung ba'i nges pa gsungs pa/ phal pa'i lus la 'babs pa ma yin na// dag pa'i rten la 'bar ba'i me bsgrubs te// de yis phung po nges par bsreg par byed//

bde chen gyi lam gyis mya ngan las 'das pa'i bag chags 'dzin par gsungs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sgom pa de nyid kyis// nges par yul gyi rkyen las sgom pa las// rmi lam shes pa de yi rjes su 'jug ༈ gegs sel mdor bstan pa/ lus la gnas pa'i rlung dang nad gzhi rtsigs// gyen du 'phang zhing 'og tu bcings pa dang*// thad kar bsrang zhing rang sar gzhil bar bya// yang na dgang zhing zug rngu'i gnas su 'phang*// gegs sel rgyas par bshad pa la// rlung log pa'i gnyen po bsam gtan gyis bcos pa/ sa dang me dang chu dang rlung rnams kyang*// dgra dang grogs su rang bzhin gnas pa las// tsha grang (505)gnyen po'i rim pas sbyar bar bya// steng 'og gis bcings pas skyon gnyis sel bar gsungs pa/ steng gi nyes pa 'og tu bcings pas sel// 'og gi logs rnams steng gi de bzhin no// gyen du 'phangs pas nad gdon pa/ ha ha hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra/ steng du bsgrags pas rtsigs ma 'don pa dang*// dwangs ma rang gi gnas su 'dzin par byed// rlung mtho ba'i skyon thur du bcings pas sel ba/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ gyi ni yi ge'i sgras// dkyil 'khor rab tu g.yo bas bsgrag cing gdab// rtsol ba drag pos rtsa gsum 'og tu bsdam// 'byed 'dzum des ni rtsigs ma thur du 'gro// grang rlung gis bskyed pa'i nad thad kar dbyung ba/ thad ka'i gzer zug drod dang bral ba rnams// rang rang gnas sam bskyed pa'i rtsa sgo nas// zug rngu de ni thad kar dbyung bar bya// lam mthar ma phyin na btsan thabs su gong du 'pho ba gsungs pa/ sgo dgu'i rgyu ba nang du bsdus pa las// khro bo'i gzugs kyis rang gnas bde bar byed// gyad kyi stobs kyis sgra gcan las su rung*// de tshe gang zhing gcud la rab tu 'phangs// sngon du 'chi ltas mthong na bslu ba'i thabs gsungs pa/ gling bzhi dang ni ri rab gang la yang*// bdag po gsum gsum rlung sems las su rung*//

'chi ltas brtag pa gsungs pa/ gling bzhi dang ni ri rab gang la yang*// nyi zla'i rgyu ba 'gags par gyur pa'i tshe// de yi tshe na 'byung ba 'khrugs par gsungs// grang ba'i nad dbyug pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis sel ba/ grang ba'i phyogs ni stobs kyi sbyor bas sel// tsha ba'i nad ting nge 'dzin dang rlung sbyor gyis sel ba/ drod la nges par bsil ba'i chu rgyun dbab// steng 'og gi rlung drag tu 'gags pa sel ba/ rang sa'i rgyun lam rab tu 'gags pa la// 'phang zhing brdung ba'i sbyor bas sel bar 'gyur// zug rngu gnas su 'phang ba rgyas par bshad pa gsungs pa/ gang du gcud pa de ni stobs kyi rlung*// dgang zhing (506)gcud la dbyung bas rab tu sel// de ltar gegs sel gyi 'bras bu gsungs pa/ lus kyi nad 'joms stobs dang bde ba rgyas/ ༈ bsnyen sgrub gsum bsgom pas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gsungs pa/ rtsa sbyangs pa las lus kyi dri ma dag /rlung sbyangs pa las ngag gi dri ma dag /'dzag med thob pas yid kyi bag chags bcom// mthar thug sgrub pa chen po bsgom pas nges don gyi dam tshig bzhir 'gyur bar gsungs pa/ 'khor lo'i mdud pa dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis bshig / nges don gyi dam tshig dga' ba bzhis sgrib pa rnams dang bral bas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa spong ba'i tshul gsungs pa/ ma rig sems ni rgyal ba log pas dwangs// chags bral nyams pas zhe sdang zad pa'i sems// chags pa dag pas bde ba chen por grol// ma rig pa'i yan lag rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags pas bden don yan lag bcu gnyis kyi 'bras bu thob tshul gsungs pa/ nor bu nas ni gtsug tor 'khor lo'i bar// brgya phrag bco brgyad las kyi rlung 'gags pas// rim pa bzhin du sa re thob par 'gyur// rdo rje'i gzhung 'di nyid zab cing rgya che bar bstan pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams kyi/ snying gi gnad rnams 'di gzhung rtogs pas thob//

dga' ba bcu drug gnas pa las de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa'i thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur bar gsungs pa/ lus dang phung po'i sgrib pa bcom pa las// sems la 'dzin pa'i bag chags mi skye bas// nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba'i rgyu skar bzhin// rim pa 'dis ni thams cad mkhyen thob 'gyur// lam gyi 'bras bu bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur tshul gsungs pa/ 'dzag pa las ni dug gsum sems skye bas// 'di yi rim pas 'dzag pa zad pa las// nyon mongs sgrib pa'i bdud las rgyal gyur pa'i// rim pa 'dis ni dug gsum 'joms par byed// lam dus su phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams brten par gsungs pa/ bdud rtsi lnga yi dwangs mas rtsigs zos pas// (507)rtsigs med dngas ma'i lus su gyur pa'i tshe// thogs bcas dngos po'i bdud dang bral ba'i phyir// 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru 'di yis 'grub// rdo rje'i gzhung 'di nyid yi ger 'bri ba'i rgyu mtshan gsungs pa/ 'di don byin rlabs stobs kyis snang ba rnams// rang gi rtog dpyod blo yis ma 'dres par// rtog dpyod brjed pas 'jigs nas yi ger bkod// nongs zhing 'khrul pa yod na bzod par gsol// rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung rdzogs so// 'di'i sa bcad rnams yig rnying las byung ba ji lta ba bzhin bris pa yin la/ don mdor bsdus pa'ang*/ sku gsum thugs kyi bsnyen sgrub gsum/ bogs 'byin gegs sel 'bras bu'o// zhes rnam pa drug tu shes par bya'o// maṅga laṃ/ ༈ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi yan lag /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros gnang ba'i thabs lam gyi gzhung bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ rje grub thob chen pos/ o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams su byon pa'i dus su/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gdams pa re re gnang ba las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa/ rlung can rlung med dag gis nyi zla bzung*// gling bzhi gcud cing nyid lag bskum dang bgrad// rgya mtsho bskol dang srin po 'og tu mnan// sgra gcan rgyas pas skyon dag yon tan rdzogs// ces so// rin chen mkha' 'gros/

sngon 'gro'i dus su g.yon pa'i lag nyid ni// bsnun ldan chu skyes dag la bde ba sgom// dbab dang bzung bzlog dgram pa'i las rnams kyis// dngos gzhi dag la gding dang ldan par 'gyur// ces so// padma mkha' 'gros/ ting 'dzin rlung dang lag pa'i phyag rgya yis// byang sems bde ba chen por phab byas te// rgya mtsho bcom zhing smad la dgram par bya// rlung sems thig le gyen du bus pas sel// ces so// sna tshogs mkha' 'gros/ smad kyi nywa bzhi g.yas g.yon steng (508)'og brdob/ stod kyi nya bzhi khu tshur gyen du brkyang*// bde drod rlung gnyis thabs shes gcig tu bsdu// shes rab dwangs ma dmar po dbang du 'gyur// ces so// phyag len yan lag bla ma'i drung du zhus// dmar khrid thob na rin chen gser las dga'// de ltar min na mun pa'i mda' dang mtshungs// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs 'jug pa gces// snod ldan slob ma'i tshogs dang 'phrad par shog /thabs lam gyi gzhung ngo*// yang khyad par gyi gdams pa/ ā li kā li mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshe// mtha' bzhi bsgrad la ma ning rlung dang bcas// zla ba'i dngas mas rtsigs ma ma lus za// 'chi med rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob byed// stod kyi nyi zla mchan khung khu tshur mnan// 'khyil pa'i 'dug stangs ru sbal tshang du bcing*// shes rab lte ba'i a la rim gyis thim// spyi bo'i haṃ la zhugs pas bde chen ster// tshangs pa'i brtul zhugs nyi zla thad kar bskyang*// 'khor lo kun tu yig drug rdo rje'i sgra// dwangs ma thim zhing bzhad pa'i sgra yis phul// nyi ma zla ba 'dres nas 'ja' lus 'grub// thabs shes nyams blangs gling bzhi bcud la 'bor// rdo rje padma bskyod cing ma ning 'cha'// thad ka thad kar ril 'dzin rjes su gzhig /thabs shes 'dres nas nam mkha'i lus su 'gyur// ces gsungs so// maṅga laṃ/ ༈ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dang 'brel ba'i smon lam gyi rdo rje'i glu grub chen o rgyan pas gnang ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/

bla ma la mchod par brjod pa/ cir snang bde chen rol pa'i ngang*// mtha' yas rig pa sems kyi gdangs// spang blang med par mngon gyur pa'i// rje rgod tshang pa la skyabs su mchi// yi dam gyi shis pa brjod pa/ stong nyid snying rje gcig pa la// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i phrin las kyis// las can rnams la dngos grub ster// yum ye shes (509)mkha' 'gro'i thugs rjes zungs// sku rdo rje sor bsam bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor/ gzhi lus la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams kyang*// steng 'og bar du bcings pa yis// rnam par rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul chad// rtog med rang gsal skyed du gsol// gsung rdo rje srog 'dzin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor/ rlung steng 'og bar gsum gcig tu bsres// yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra// rlung skyon steng 'og thad kar bton// rlung lnga las su rung bar shog / thugs rdo rje rjes ting sgrub pa chen po'i rnal 'byor/ khams dgu 'dus pa bcud kyi dwangs// srid pa'i skye sgo gyen la bzlog /rtsa yi mdud pa phyogs med grol// gsung gi dbang phyug thob par shog /lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bur brtan// brtsigs kyi bdud rtsi ma lus zad// dwangs ma bdud rtsi'i nus pa yis// 'ja' lus chos sku thob par shog / lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus te bstan pa/ sna tshogs rig pa sems kyi gdangs// dpag tu med pa'i 'char sgo la// spang blang gnyen pos ma bslad par// gang shar chos skur rtogs par shog /yul dang yul can gnyis su med// rang snang rig pa'i 'char tshul rnams// rtogs pa'i stobs kyis gcig tu 'dres// gzhan snang zil gyis gnon par shog /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal rnams// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'khor lor mthong*// brtse chen dmigs med thugs rje yis// bde chen sa la 'khod par shog / mjug sbyar byang ngo*// tshig 'di rnams bod yul gtsang gi yul// zong 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i tshong dus su// mi che btsan rags dgu 'dus pa'i nang*// nga o rgyan pa yis skyugs pa yin/// /maṅga laṃ//
